record.question: Which of the following statements below correctly describe the term 'Nutraceuticals'?
options: Foods that help are or herbal origin or plant based
Food that helps mask the taste of unpalatable medicines
Food that helps balance acidity in the stomach
Food that provides additional health benefit to the body
record.explanation: Answer D: Food that provides additional health benefit to the body. A nutraceutical is a food or food component that provides health benefits beyond basic nutrition; the final option is the best broad definition. Source/context note: “Nutraceutical” has no single uniform regulatory definition across jurisdictions. Reference: https://www.fda.gov/food/dietary-supplements. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
